visualCharacteristics: Full-width slider of image-only promotional banners (banner text is baked into the artwork). Each slide image links to a promotion or article. Prev/next chevron arrow buttons sit on the left and right edges, vertically centred over the image; slide indicators below.
contentPattern: One row per slide, two columns: cell 1 holds the banner image (linked to the slide target, or the link may be placed in cell 2); cell 2 holds optional text content. When cell 2 contains only a link, the link is moved onto the image and the cell is removed.
usage: Hero promotional banner rotator at the top of landing pages such as https://www.safra.sg/nsman-magazine.
reuseGuidance: Use for full-width, image-only linked promo banners with edge arrows. Use the standard carousel when slides carry text overlays or multiple items per view.
